test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In March 2021, the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports decided to extend which sports scheme from 2021-22 to 2025-26?

options.text: Sports and Games for Persons with Disabilities Scheme

solution:
The correct answer is __**Khelo India Scheme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Khelo India Scheme**

__
 
• **Khelo India Programme** is a national **yojana/scheme for the development of sports in India.**
 
• It was** launched in the year 2018 by Sports Minister Col. Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore in Delhi. **
 
• This program has been launched **to improve the sports culture in India.**
 
• The Ministry has chosen to **extend the Khelo India program through 2025–2026.**
 
• The Ministry of Finance has received a document from the Expenditure Finance Committee (EFC) requesting the continuation of the Khelo India Scheme from 2021–2022 to 2025–2026

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Come and Play Scheme**

 
• The Come and Play Scheme was established to encourage local athletes in locations where SAI sports facilities/Centres are open in order to make the best use of the organization's sporting resources in Delhi and around the nation.

**Sports and Games for Persons with Disabilities Scheme**

 
• The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports launched the "Sports and Games for Persons with Disabilities Scheme" as a Central Sector Scheme in 2009–2010, which was part of the XI Plan Period.
 
• The Scheme's main goal is to get as many disabled people involved in sports as possible. 

**Target Olympic Podium Scheme**

 
• Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) seeks to give potential competitors for the Olympic Games/Paralympic Games and other important international competitions all the necessary support and assistance so they can take home medals.
